- **Charlie (age 10):** Although Charlie has been in hospital for 4 weeks (which is under the 12-week threshold that would typically affect eligibility), you still cannot claim because you don't live in the UK.

The UK residency requirement is the primary barrier preventing you from claiming Child Benefit. If you were to move to the UK and establish residency there, you might want to reconsider applying at that time.
